title: Corner Shower Shelf (w/ Drainage) – Screw Mounted
author: nikos_bs
description:
Keep your shower essentials off the floor with a clean, minimal corner shelf designed for wet environments. The slotted surface lets water drain quickly, helping soap and bottles dry faster and reducing buildup.

### Features

- Corner-fit design with a curved front edge
- Drainage slats for fast drying
- Simple 2-screw wall mounting
- Easy to print and clean

### Recommended materials (wet area)

- **Best:** PETG / ASA / ABS
- PLA

### Print recommendations

- Orientation: **print as-is (flat shelf on the bed)**
- Supports: **Off**
- Layer height: **0.20 mm**
- Walls/Perimeters: **4–6** (more = stronger mounts)
- Infill: **25–40%** (Gyroid recommended)

### Hardware & installation

- **2× M4 screws** \+ **2× wall plugs/anchors** (choose size appropriate for your wall/tile)
- Optional: a tiny bead of **neutral-cure silicone** behind the mount contact areas to reduce water ingress (don’t block drainage slots).

### Notes

This is intended for typical shower items (soap, shampoo, etc.). Use proper anchors and check the shelf periodically for tightness.
